conclusion: Rosetta remote transport works for a sacrificial translated amd64 executable and exposes valid x86 instruction/stack registers. It does not establish useful symbolicated multi-thread or Swift task stacks: only an unnamed initial loader frame was seen, and detach failed. Ordinary ptrace attachment remains unusable.
